drafts.emptyFiltered: No videos found with the selected filter.

preview.cannotPreviewHevc: Your browser can't preview this video — this is common for HEVC/H.265 clips (e.g. iPhone “High Efficiency” recordings). That's fine: it will still upload and be converted so it plays for everyone.

rc.title: Not enough Resource Credits
rc.explanation: Every post on the Hive blockchain costs a small amount of Resource Credits (RC) — a free allowance that refills on its own over time. Right now your account doesn't have enough RC to publish this video, so the upload can't be finished yet.
rc.refillsHint: Your RC refills automatically — just check back later, or come back when it's topped up.
rc.blockedHint: Even at a full bar your account doesn't have enough RC for a post yet. This usually means very little Hive Power. Powering up a little HP — or receiving an RC delegation — will fix it. New to Hive? Reach out on the <discordLink>3Speak Discord</discordLink> and we'll help you get started.

guests.title: Guest list
guests.note: These Hive accounts can watch without 3Speak Pro. The list is kept private on our servers and is never published to your post, so nobody can see who you shared it with.

details.shortDescLimit: Maximum 240 characters reached for short descriptions.

errors.tagRequired: Please add at least one tag
errors.tooManyTags: You can add up to {{max}} tags — the community tag is added automatically.

details.title: Title
details.descriptionPlaceholder: Write your video description here... Supports markdown formatting!

community.label: Community
community.info: Which Hive community this video is posted to. It becomes the post's category, so community feeds and moderation follow it.

rewards.label: Rewards
rewards.info: Optional "Hive Reward Pool" distribution method. Choose the default 50/50 split, power up 100% of the payout, or decline rewards entirely.
rewards.declineHint: Take no rewards for this post.

beneficiaries.label: Beneficiaries
beneficiaries.info: Other accounts that should get a percentage of this post's rewards. Useful for co-creators, editors, or the original author of a clip.

remix.label: Allow Remix/Clip
remix.info: Allow others to create remixes and clips from this video. You will be credited as original author and receive a minimum of 5% in beneficiaries.

nsfw.label: Mark as NSFW
nsfw.info: Flags this video as adult content. It will be hidden from feeds and search for viewers who have not enabled NSFW, and tagged nsfw across Hive.

ads.label: Ads on this video
ads.info: Your account carries ads, so this video does too unless you turn it off here. This only affects this one video; your other videos and your account setting stay as they are.
ads.hintOn: Ads may play on this video.

gated.label: Supporters only
gated.info: Encrypts this video so only 3Speak Pro subscribers can play it. A 10 second unencrypted preview is published alongside it, so the post still shows a trailer everywhere on Hive. Your title, description and tags are ordinary Hive post content and are not encrypted — only the video is. This cannot be changed after upload.

trailer.label: Channel trailer
trailer.info: Plays automatically at the top of your profile's Overview tab, replacing any trailer you set before.

schedule.label: Schedule this post
schedule.info: Queues the post and publishes it automatically at the time you choose, at least 15 minutes from now and up to 90 days out. It is broadcast by @threespeak on your behalf, so you will be asked to authorize that once.
schedule.note: At least 15 minutes from now, up to 90 days. Posted automatically by @threespeak on your behalf — you will be asked to authorize this once.
